open_findings: BOOKKEEPING ADVANCE from 9a74604's full review at 2657868, one merge later: the only watched-path drift is PR #227's three files (zaf-build/assets/deploy.js, zaf-build/manifest.json 1.0.69->1.0.70, scripts/config-matrix-probe.js), verified by `git diff --name-only 9a74604..97e41f3` over the watched set. That delta received its own targeted review on 2026-08-18 (session 98f50d7d, before the full review): the skip guard is a strict-equality allowlist of the one non-field key, the digits-only substitute() gate is untouched and enforced in the upload path (deploy.js:1435-1442 post-merge numbering), renderSteps escapes both interpolated halves, and the CI probe extension runs under contents:read on push/pull_request only. No new review work in this record; the four register rows and all dispositions carry unchanged from 9a74604. Four register-lane findings remain in SECURITY_REGISTER.md (register: 4).

REGISTER MEDIUM, the reason this review exists: the committed record sat at 4cbca06 (2026-07-29) for 20 days while 61 commits shipped in releases v1.0.61 through v1.0.69, every one publishing with the gate's NOT-covered flag; a review session ran 2026-08-01 at 2cfd42e (tsanet_ops.agent_sessions receipt) but never committed its record advance, and the mandatory HIGH-surface delta trigger did not fire again until PR #227's review on 2026-08-18. This commit closes the coverage gap; the open residual is process (a record commit is not part of a review's definition of done, and nothing probes for a review session newer than the committed reviewed_at).

VERIFIED CLOSURES, checked on GitHub this round rather than carried: #144 (releases exist through v1.0.69), #156 (tag allowlist off the prototype chain, a000a23), #157 (stripHtml can no longer emit a tag opener, e93c15f), #164 (declared audit-anchor replaces the inferred v1-base heuristic, #200/e95eb77), #166 (SLA poller inbound-only, 58db8ce), #201 (undecodable-file guard, #199). #194 remains OPEN (low): finding counts vs deduped detail lines.

NEW MEMBER-REACHING SURFACES REVIEWED, the window's substance. #209 shared author: all four bundle author_id sites carry the placeholder; the inbound creation body preserves true origin in text ('from {{$.partner_name}}.{{$.submitter_line}}'); the three finish notes are system messages, public:false; no flow writes inbound partner notes as Zendesk comments (three flows total: handle_ping, field_action, forward_comment), so the configured author never masks a partner note author. #223 partner form fields: the sidebar renderer (main.js:525-533) Array.isArray-guards, object-filters, and esc()-wraps both fieldName and value into text positions; main.js esc() escapes quotes as well as angle brackets (main.js:1469-1472), and the only data-into-attribute site (collab.status into a double-quoted class) is therefore quote-safe; the jq side carries the matching []?|objects guard. #224 auto-accept: default FALSE in the manifest (member opt-in); GuardAutoAccept compares a DEPLOY-BAKED CONSTANT (the jq expr sets auto_accept from the literal AUTO_ACCEPT_MODE, substituted 'on'/'off' by deploy.js:522), so a forged delivery cannot enable it and an unsubstituted bundle evaluates off (fail-safe polarity, deploy.js:516-520, QUICK_START 4b table); GuardCreate filters eventType==collaboration-request.created; failure path posts an internal note instructing manual accept; success posts an internal 'accepted automatically' note, so the in-ticket audit trail survives automation. The residual it raises on #90's accepted limitation is the register's second row.

CATEGORY WALK, receipts in the session transcript. 1 supply chain: no release-pipeline change; all six workflows push/pull_request only (no pull_request_target, no workflow_run), permissions declared, third-party actions SHA-pinned, SRI intact on all three HTML pages (mechanical PASS lines); the new CI probes (config-matrix, sidebar, compare) run under contents:read. 2 credentials: no new credential; Zendesk-side ZIS connection migrated to OAuth ahead of the API-token retirement (zis/README, validated 2026-07-07); rotation runbook present; tsanet_password remains the only secure parameter. 3 authn/authz: inbound authenticity unchanged (callbackAuth BASIC; X-Hub-Signature-256 present on deliveries but unverifiable in ZIS, the accepted #90 limitation); auto-accept gating verified as above; allowed_action_roles unchanged. 4 data flow: domainWhitelist still exactly the two connect2 hosts; the outbound-destinations table (SECURITY_CONSIDERATIONS.md, added in-window) enumerates all five destinations with initiator, credential and data columns, including the deploy screen's unauthenticated api.github.com release check whose response gates nothing and renders only through the esc()-wrapped row renderer (renderStatus -> renderSteps, deploy.js:1162); the bundle writes comments via plain body, never html_body (zero hits); no href/src built from data and no single-quoted attribute in built markup on any of the three HTML/JS surfaces; the caveat the register's fourth row records: domainWhitelist constrains the ZAF proxy path only, direct cors:true fetches are constrained by review, not tooling; Accept-path additions (#213/#215/#216) send ticket id and agent-typed instructions to the partner, covered by the table's case-data row at destination level; the identifier-class and stored-artifact inventory gaps are the register's third row. Toggle semantics: setting changes take effect at next deploy, documented (QUICK_START.md:546) and surfaced as drift on the deploy screen's Current state card. 5 audit: auto-accept leaves an in-ticket system note both on success and failure; shared author preserves true origin in body text. 6 platform-gated: #90 (HMAC), #119 (Entra Origin), both re-checked as still gated; the auto-accept residual on #90 is register row 2. 7 untrusted rendering: the #223 renderer and the full card path re-swept as above; #156 and #157 closures verified on GitHub and their fixes read in the tree.
